Single |pvp_ranged_damage = [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]]3 |pvp_ranged_firerate = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]0.225 |pvp_ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]30 |pvp_speed = 5.5 |pvp_hidden = {{Attr|Hidden|Yes}} |pvp_lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} (Collision only) |pvp_flying = No }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Humvee 3''' ('''High Mobility Multipurpose Wheeled Vehicle Version 3''') is the third vehicle that spawns from the [[Military Base]]. In-game, it is meant to be referred to as just ''Humvee'', though it has been referenced here as '''Humvee 3''' to differentiate itself from other [[Military Base]] units. It spawns when the [[Military Base]] is at Level 3. As with other [[units]], it starts from the end of the map path and moves towards the entrance of the map. The '''Humvee 3''' has a spawnrate of 35 seconds, which is reduced down to 25 seconds in [[PVP]] mode. It is slightly slower than the [[Humvee 2]]. Unlike the [[Humvee]] and [[Humvee 2]], the '''Humvee 3''' has a mounted gun on its roof which a passenger uses to attack enemies. When firing, it will slow down, giving it more time to attack enemies. This gun can detect hidden enemies, but cannot detect flying enemies or damage lead enemies. There is a limit of three units per [[Military Base]], limiting the amount of '''Humvee 3s''' that can spawn. This however generally should not be an issue, due to how hard it is to reach this limit. ==Appearance== The current version of the '''Humvee 3''' is a khaki-colored and typical in appearance to other Humvees in real life. It has a bullbar on the front, with barbed wire attached to it. It has black windshields, black antennas near the back of the vehicle, black wheels and yellow headlights. On top of the vehicle there is a mounted machine gun, protected by various shields. It is operated by a humanoid with tan skin, black shirt and mask, and green goggles. == Skins == {| class="light-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:ClassicHumvee3.png|175px]] |[[File:WastelandHumvee3.png|175px]] |[[File:CyberHumvee3.png|175px]] |[[File:Base1776Humvee3.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Premium|Classic}} |{{Color|Hexscape|Wasteland}} |{{Color|Deluxe|Cyber}} |{{Color|Patriotic|Base 1776}} |- !Obtained From |[[Premium Crate]] |[[Hexscape Event#Hexscape Event Battle Pass|Hexscape Event Premium Battle Pass]] |[[Deluxe Crate]] |''🦅 Eagle Screech'' [[Mission Quests|Mission Quest]],
[[Patriotic Crate]] |- ! |[[File:IceCreamHumvee3.png|175px]] |[[File:PirateHumvee3.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Beach|Ice Cream}} |{{Color|Pirate|Pirate}} |- !Obtained From |[[Beach Crate]] |[[Pirate Crate]] |} ==Strategy== *The '''Humvee 3''' is great for high health enemies that spawn early on during the game, like the [[Normal Boss]] or [[Elite Abnormal]]. **The '''Humvee 3''' is useful for enemies that spawn other enemies, like the [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]], as it can shoot down spawned enemies. **The '''Humvee 3''' can be quite useful against hidden enemies, as it has hidden detection. ***The '''Humvee 3''' also cannot collide with [[Ghost (Attribute)|Ghost]] enemies, like the [[Soul]]. *On two-pathed maps, only one '''Humvee 3''' will spawn per Level 3 [[Military Base]]. It will go down a random path. *The '''Humvee 3''' can deal full collision damage to enemies with defense, like the [[Fallen Squire]] or [[Elite Abnormal]]. **However, the '''Humvee 3's''' gun damage is still affected by defense. *The '''Humvee 3''' is not affected by any buff or debuff. *The '''Humvee 3''' will struggle against any enemy with abilities that damage units because of its low health. **For example, if the [[Fallen King]] uses its ''Sword Swing'' attack, and a '''Humvee 3''' is caught in the attack, it is instantly destroyed. ==Trivia== *The '''Humvee 3''' is based on the [[wp:Humvee|military vehicle of the same name]] made by AM General, as evidenced by its similar design and same name. *Initially, the [[Truck3]] was named the ''Humvee3'' when it was added, even though it was not similar to a Humvee vehicle in any way. **Interestingly, the '''Humvee 3''' directly replaced the [[Truck3]]. *The upgrade icon for the Level 3 [[Military Base]] does not show the barbed wire on the bullbar, unlike the original '''Humvee 3''' model. *The original '''Humvee 3''' model appeared in the third and second version of [[Forest Camp]] as decoration. == Update History == {{scroll|text = *'''13 October 2019''' -
